verdicts.title: A weight-formula for all highest weight modules, and a higher order parabolic category $\mathcal{O}$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a complex Kac-Moody algebra, with Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$. Also fix a weight $λ\in\mathfrak{h}^*$. For $M(λ)\twoheadrightarrow V$ an arbitrary highest weight $\mathfrak{g}$-module, we provide a cancellation-free, non-recursive formula for the weights of $V$. This is novel even in finite type, and is obtained from $λ$ and a collection $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{H}_V$ of independent sets in the Dynkin diagram of $\mathfrak{g}$ that are associated to $V$.

verdicts.title: Pruning Boolean d-DNNF Circuits Through Tseitin-Awareness
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Boolean circuits in d-DNNF form enable tractable probabilistic inference.
